text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It's almost my turn. This line was so<n>long, but my
wait is almost over!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Here we go! One airline bento box,<n>please!

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
I'm really sorry, ma'am, but we're<n>all sold out of
those at the moment.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Say it's not so! My beloved<n>airline bento? Sold
out?! Nooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl is devastated that<n>she couldn't
buy the bento box<n>she'd been looking forward to
eating.
